entities.name: Lőrinc Mészáros
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lőrinc Mészáros is a Hungarian businessman and former politician who served as mayor of the Hungarian village Felcsút between 2011 and 2018. With an estimated wealth of 1,241 trillion forints as of December 2024, he is the richest person in Hungary. Several media outlets refer to him as an "oligarch".
